parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle to clone.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle to clone.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the rectangle to clone.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the rectangle to clone.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The pixel format for the cloned area.

parameters.name: srcBitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap.

parameters.name: dstBitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. Otherwise, it returns an error status.

function.name: GdipCloneImage
function.description: This function clones an image. If the image is a bitmap, it clones the bitmap area. If the image is a metafile, it creates a new metafile and copies the attributes from the original metafile. If the image is neither a bitmap nor a metafile, it returns an error.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The original image to be cloned.

parameters.name: cloneImage
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to store the cloned image.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are null or the image type is not supported, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, or 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromFile
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a file, using a filename and a pointer to a bitmap object.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: This is the name of the file from which the bitmap will be created.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a bitmap object where the created bitmap will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If the parameters are invalid, it returns 'InvalidParameter'. If the file cannot be read, it returns the status of the failed operation.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromGdiDib
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a device-independent bitmap (DIB) using GDI+.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the DIB bit values.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpBitmap pointer that receives the bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. If any of the parameters is NULL, it returns InvalidParameter.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromFileICM
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a file using Image Color Management (ICM).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file to create the bitmap from.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpBitmap object. This will be filled with the created bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns Ok. If the function fails, it returns one of the error statuses.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromResource
function.description: This function loads a bitmap from a resource, creates a GDI+ bitmap from it, and then deletes the original bitmap.

parameters.name: hInstance
parameters.description: Handle to the instance of the module whose executable file contains the bitmap to be loaded.

parameters.name: lpBitmapName
parameters.description: Pointer to a null-terminated string that contains the name of the bitmap resource to be loaded.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpBitmap pointer that receives the bitmap from the resource.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns 'Ok'. If the function fails, it returns an error status code.

function.name: blend_argb_no_bkgnd_alpha
function.description: This function blends a source color with a background color, without considering the background's alpha. The blending is done per channel (red, green, blue) and the result is returned as a DWORD.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The source color, represented as a DWORD. Each byte represents a channel (blue, green, red, alpha), from least significant to most significant.

parameters.name: bkgnd
parameters.description: The background color, represented as a DWORD. Each byte represents a channel (blue, green, red, alpha), from least significant to most significant.

function.return_type: DWORD, representing the blended color. Each byte represents a channel (blue, green, red, alpha), from least significant to most significant.

function.name: GdipCreateHBITMAPFromBitmap
function.description: This function creates a Windows DIB section from a GDI+ bitmap, and returns a handle to the DIB section.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to the GDI+ bitmap to convert.

parameters.name: hbmReturn
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the handle to the DIB section.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Specifies the background color.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It returns 'Ok' if successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromGraphics
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from graphics using specified width, height and target. It also checks for invalid parameters and returns the status of bitmap creation.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bitmap to be created

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bitmap to be created

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The target graphics from which the bitmap is to be created

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: A pointer to the bitmap that will be created

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the bitmap creation operation

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromHICON
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a handle to an icon (HICON).

parameters.name: hicon
parameters.description: Handle to the icon to create the bitmap from.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpBitmap object where the created bitmap will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok if the operation was successful, InvalidParameter if the parameters are not valid, GenericError for a generic error, or OutOfMemory if there was not enough memory to complete the operation.

function.name: generate_halftone_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette by manipulating the entries of an ARGB array based on the count.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: A pointer to an array of ARGB entries to be manipulated.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of entries to be manipulated in the ARGB array.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything as it modifies the ARGB array in place.

function.name: get_screen_resolution
function.description: This function gets the screen resolution in pixels per inch along the screen width (x-axis) and height (y-axis).

parameters.name: xres
parameters.description: A pointer to a REAL type where the function will store the screen resolution along the x-axis.

parameters.name: yres
parameters.description: A pointer to a REAL type where the function will store the screen resolution along the y-axis.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation was successful, 'GenericError' if it failed.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromScan0
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a block of memory, using the specified width, height, stride, pixel format, and optional scan0 pointer. It also sets the bitmap's properties and flags based on the pixel format.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: The byte offset between the beginning of one scan line and the next. This is usually (but not necessarily) the number of bytes in the pixel format (for example, 2 for 16 bits per pixel) multiplied by the width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The pixel format of the bitmap.

parameters.name: scan0
parameters.description: A pointer to the memory block that contains the bitmap data.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: A pointer to the pointer of the GpBitmap object to be created.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. It can also return 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid, or 'OutOfMemory' if the memory allocation fails.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromStream
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a stream. It first loads the image from the stream, checks if the image type is a bitmap, and if not, disposes the image and returns an error. If the image type is a bitmap, it returns Ok.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream from which the bitmap is created.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a GpBitmap object. If the function is successful, this parameter will point to the created bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus. This represents the status of the function execution. It returns Ok if the function is successful, otherwise it returns an error status.

function.name: GdipCreateBitmapFromStreamICM
function.description: This function creates a bitmap from a stream using Image Color Management (ICM).

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream from which the bitmap is created.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a GpBitmap object. The function will set this to point to the newly created bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns Ok. If the function fails, it returns one of the error statuses.

function.name: GdipCreateCachedBitmap
function.description: This function creates a cached bitmap from a given bitmap and graphics object. It checks for valid parameters, allocates memory for the new cached bitmap, clones the image from the original bitmap to the new one, and handles any errors that may occur during these processes.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Pointer to the original bitmap to be cached

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object associated with the bitmap

parameters.name: cachedbmp
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the new cached bitmap to be created

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the function execution. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are NULL, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation for the new cached bitmap fails, or 'Ok' if the function executes successfully

function.name: GdipCreateHICONFromBitmap
function.description: This function creates an HICON from a GpBitmap object. It locks the bitmap, calculates the size and stride of the bitmap, allocates memory for the bitmap, and then creates the icon. If the bitmap cannot be locked or memory cannot be allocated, it returns an error status.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GpBitmap object from which the HICON will be created.

parameters.name: hicon
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the HICON that will be created from the bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If the bitmap cannot be locked, it returns 'InvalidParameter'. If memory cannot be allocated, it returns 'OutOfMemory'.

function.name: GdipDeleteCachedBitmap
function.description: This function deletes a cached bitmap, disposes its image and frees the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: cachedbmp
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the cached bitmap that is to be deleted.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameter is null, otherwise returns 'Ok' after successful deletion and disposal of the bitmap.

function.name: GdipDrawCachedBitmap
function.description: This function draws a cached bitmap at the specified location.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics context where the bitmap will be drawn.

parameters.name: cachedbmp
parameters.description: Pointer to the cached bitmap to be drawn.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the drawn bitmap.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the drawn bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if either 'graphics' or 'cachedbmp' is NULL, otherwise it returns the status of the 'GdipDrawImage' function.

function.name: move_bitmap
function.description: This function moves a bitmap from a source to a destination. It also has the option to clobber (overwrite) the palette of the destination bitmap with the source's palette.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination bitmap where the source bitmap will be moved to.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source bitmap that will be moved to the destination bitmap.

parameters.name: clobber_palette
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the palette of the destination bitmap will be overwritten with the source's palette.

function.return_type: void, which means this function does not return a value. It performs the operation of moving the bitmap and optionally overwriting the palette.

function.name: free_image_data
function.description: This function is used to free the memory allocated to an image object. It checks the type of the image and accordingly frees the memory. It also releases any metadata reader and decoder associated with the image, terminates any encoder, and frees the palette.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image object whose memory needs to be freed.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return InvalidParameter if the image is null, ObjectBusy if the image type is invalid, or Ok if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipDisposeImage
function.description: This function disposes the image, frees the image data and sets the image type to ~0.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image to be disposed.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, otherwise returns the error status.

function.name: GdipFindFirstImageItem
function.description: This function checks the first image item in the given image. However, it's not fully implemented yet.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image where the function will look for the first item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Pointer to the item data where the function will store the first item information.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns InvalidParameter if the input parameters are null, NotImplemented if the function is called for the first time.

function.name: GdipGetImageItemData
function.description: This function is not implemented yet. It is supposed to get the image item data but currently it only increases the call count and returns a 'NotImplemented' status.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which to get the item data

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Pointer to the item data to be filled

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, currently always returns 'NotImplemented'

function.name: GdipGetImageBounds
function.description: This function retrieves the bounds of an image and the unit of measure. It checks if the image is a Metafile or a Bitmap and sets the bounds and unit accordingly. If the image is not of these types, it returns an error.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image whose bounds are to be retrieved

parameters.name: srcRect
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that receives the bounds of the image

parameters.name: srcUnit
parameters.description: Pointer to the unit of measure used for the bounds

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters is null or if the image type is not supported

function.name: GdipGetImageDimension
function.description: This function retrieves the dimensions of an image. If the image is a metafile, it converts the units to pixels. If the image is a bitmap, it directly retrieves the height and width. If the image is neither, it returns an error.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which dimensions are to be retrieved

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the width of the image will be stored

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the height of the image will be stored

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are null or if the image type is neither metafile nor bitmap

function.name: GdipGetImageGraphicsContext
function.description: This function retrieves the graphics context from an image. If the image type is a Metafile, it gets the graphics context from the Metafile. Otherwise, it gets the graphics context from the image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the graphics context is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpGraphics object. This will be filled with the graphics context from the image.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns the status of the graphics context retrieval. If either of the input parameters is NULL, it returns InvalidParameter.

function.name: GdipGetImageHeight
function.description: This function retrieves the height of an image. The height is calculated differently based on the type of the image (Metafile or Bitmap). If the image is of type Metafile, the height is calculated using the units_to_pixels function. If the image is of type Bitmap, the height is directly accessed from the image object. If the image is of an unknown type, the function returns an error.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image object whose height is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an unsigned integer where the height of the image will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If either of the input parameters is NULL or if the image is of an unknown type, it returns 'InvalidParameter'.

function.name: GdipGetImageHorizontalResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the horizontal resolution of an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the horizontal resolution is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: A pointer to a REAL type variable where the retrieved horizontal resolution will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are null, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipGetImagePaletteSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of the color palette of an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the palette size is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: A pointer to an integer that will receive the size of the palette.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It returns 'InvalidParameter' if the image or size is null, 'GenericError' if the image type is Metafile, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipGetImagePixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of an image. If the image is not a bitmap, it sets the pixel format to 24-bit RGB. Otherwise, it sets the pixel format to the format of the bitmap image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image from which the pixel format is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a PixelFormat variable. The function sets this to the pixel format of the image.

function.return_type: GpStatus. This represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns 'Ok'. If either of the input pointers is NULL, it returns 'InvalidParameter'.

function.name: GdipGetImageRawFormat
function.description: This function gets the raw format of an image and copies it into a GUID structure.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which the raw format is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID structure where the raw format of the image will be copied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if either of the parameters is NULL.

function.name: GdipGetImageType
function.description: This function retrieves the type of an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image whose type is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the type of the image.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if either parameter is NULL.

function.name: GdipGetImageVerticalResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the vertical resolution of an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the vertical resolution is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: A pointer to a REAL where the vertical resolution of the image will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are null, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipGetImageWidth
function.description: This function retrieves the width of an image. If the image is of type Metafile, it converts the width from units to pixels. If the image is of type Bitmap, it directly retrieves the width. If the image is of any other type, it returns an error.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the width is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer where the width of the image will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are null or the image type is not supported.

function.name: GdipGetPropertyCount
function.description: This function retrieves the count of properties associated with an image. If the image is of type Bitmap and has a property item or a metadata reader, the count is updated accordingly.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which to retrieve the property count.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the property count will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the image or num is null, otherwise returns 'Ok'.

function.name: GdipGetPropertyIdList
function.description: This function retrieves the list of property identifiers for the specified image. If the image does not have any properties, the function returns an empty list. The function also handles various error conditions, such as invalid parameters or unsupported property types.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image for which to retrieve the property identifiers.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: The number of property identifiers to retrieve.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to the list that receives the property identifiers.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok if the operation is successful, InvalidParameter if the parameters are not valid, NotImplemented if the image type is not supported, or other status codes depending on the result of internal operations.

function.name: propvariant_size
function.description: This function calculates the size of a PROPVARIANT value, taking into account its type and whether it is a vector. It handles several different types of PROPVARIANT, returning the size in bytes.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to the PROPVARIANT whose size is to be calculated.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the size of the PROPVARIANT in bytes.

function.name: GdipGetPropertyItemSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of a property item from a given image. If the property item is found, the size is stored in the 'size' parameter. If the property item is not found or an error occurs, an appropriate status code is returned.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which the property item size is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: propid
parameters.description: The identifier of the property item whose size is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the size of the property item.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid, 'NotImplemented' if the image type is not a bitmap, or 'PropertyNotFound' if the property item is not found.

function.name: vt_to_itemtype
function.description: This function maps a variant type to a corresponding item type.

parameters.name: vt
parameters.description: This is the variant type to be mapped to an item type.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the corresponding item type for the given variant type. If the variant type is not supported, it returns 0.

function.name: propvariant_to_item
function.description: This function converts a PROPVARIANT structure to a PropertyItem structure. It checks the size and type of the PROPVARIANT, copies the value to the PropertyItem, and sets the length, type, and id of the PropertyItem.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to the PROPVARIANT structure to be converted

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Pointer to the PropertyItem structure where the converted value will be stored

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the PROPVARIANT structure

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Property identifier for the PropertyItem

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the size or type of the PROPVARIANT is not correct.

function.name: GdipGetPropertyItem
function.description: This function retrieves a property item (metadata) from an image object. If the property item is found, it is copied into the buffer provided. The function also checks for valid parameters and handles different image types.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image object from which the property item is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: propid
parameters.description: Identifier of the property item to be retrieved.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the property item to be retrieved.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the retrieved property item will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok if the operation is successful, InvalidParameter if the parameters are not valid, NotImplemented if the image type is not supported, or PropertyNotFound if the property item is not found.

function.name: GdipGetPropertySize
function.description: This function is used to get the size and count of properties of an image. If the image type is not a bitmap, it returns NotImplemented. If the image has a property item, it calculates the size and count. If the image has a metadata reader, it reads the properties from the metadata.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which to get the property size and count

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the size of the properties

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the count of the properties

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok, InvalidParameter, NotImplemented, or PropertyNotFound depending on the conditions

function.name: GdipGetAllPropertyItems
function.description: This function retrieves all property items (metadata) from an image. It checks the image type, validates parameters, and copies the property items to a buffer. If the image's property items are not available, it uses a metadata reader to retrieve them.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to the image from which to retrieve property items.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the property items to be retrieved.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of property items to be retrieved.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer where the retrieved property items will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return Ok if the operation is successful, InvalidParameter if the parameters are not valid, NotImplemented if the image type is not supported, GenericError if the metadata reader is not available, or PropertyNotFound if the property items are not found.

function.name: GdipImageGetFrameCount
function.description: This function retrieves the number of frames in the specified dimension of an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image from which to get the frame count.

parameters.name: dimensionID
parameters.description: Pointer to the GUID that specifies the dimension.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the number of frames in the specified dimension.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if parameters are null or if dimensionID does not match with any of the image's dimensions.

function.name: GdipImageGetFrameDimensionsCount
function.description: This function checks the validity of the image and count parameters. If they are valid, it sets the count to 1. It does not yet support multiple frame dimensions.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image to get frame dimensions count from.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to an unsigned integer where the frame dimensions count will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if either parameter is null, otherwise returns 'Ok'.

function.name: GdipImageGetFrameDimensionsList
function.description: This function retrieves an array of GUIDs that represent the dimensions of frames within an image.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Pointer to the image to get the frame dimensions from.

parameters.name: dimensionIDs
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of GUIDs that receive the dimensions.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of elements in the dimensionIDs array.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipLoadImageFromFile
function.description: This function loads an image from a file into a GpImage object using a stream.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file from which the image is to be loaded.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to a GpImage object where the loaded image will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If not, it returns an error status.

function.name: GdipLoadImageFromFileICM
function.description: This function loads an image from a file using Image Color Management (ICM).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file from which the image is to be loaded.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpImage object. This is where the loaded image will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns Ok. If the function fails, it returns one of the error statuses.

function.name: add_property
function.description: This function adds a property to a bitmap. If the bitmap's property item is null, it allocates memory for a new property item. If not, it calculates the size and count of the properties, allocates memory for a new property item, and copies the existing properties into the new item. Then it sets the id, type, length, and value of the new property item, frees the old property item, and sets the bitmap's property item to the new item.

parameters.name: bitmap
